key_insight: Qutrit neural quantum kernels extend qubit NQKs to SU(3) embeddings, enabling richer data representations and strong multiclass performance in classification tasks.
engineering_relevance: For quantum ML system design, the work shows that using higher-dimensional qudits can improve classifier flexibility and may be a practical route to multiclass quantum models.
method: Pretrain a qutrit QNN and reuse the trained circuit as a task-adapted kernel embedding.
Compare 1-to-n and n-to-n kernel constructions across varying feature budgets and numbers of qutrits.
Ablate different SU(3) parameterizations to assess effects on optimization and accuracy.
evidence_signal: The study evaluates binary and three-class classification on four benchmark datasets, where qutrit NQKs outperform the corresponding QNN baselines in nearly all tested settings.
watch_item: Performance gains can saturate and depend on the dataset, system size, and the chosen SU(3) parameterization, so implementation details matter.
paper_title: Qutrit-Based Neural Quantum Kernels for Classification Tasks
